scope: Inactive proposed v060 backend, worker, context builder, reference preparation, envelope auditing and queue coordinator

findings.observed: prepare_references returns a table and a receipt with ready=false and unresolved independent audit, full viability and sealing gates. evaluate can consume that same table: reference_costs compares caller-supplied identities and receipt digest without requiring a sealed independently audited readiness authority.
findings.correction: Keep draft references separate from execution-admissible references. Require authenticated exact-cohort independent audit and sealing readiness before evaluation, and reject draft output explicitly.

findings.observed: The full hundred-case evaluation has no monotonic complete-evaluation deadline. Four sixty-second invocations per case permit hours of work despite the preserved twenty-minute complete-evaluation ceiling.
findings.correction: Enforce the fixed complete-evaluation ceiling, propagate remaining time to execution and cleanup, and classify incomplete execution as infrastructure failure without replacing measured invocations or changing score penalties.

positive_observations: Version selection remains explicit and inactive; no default or production adoption is introduced.
Fresh tiny challenge-grid completeness, repeated-instance rejection and exact three measured invocations are implemented.
Durable source, worker, supervisor and epoch evidence bindings are checked before signing.
Accepted submission transition precedes result insertion in the reviewed queue correction.
limits: Source review and local tests do not prove native accounting, reference viability, production cohort readiness or contract approval.
